dct_title_s: Muscatine County, Iowa, 1937, aerial photomosaic index
dct_description_sm: Title supplied by cataloger based on information from sheet labels. Images are photoreductions of mosaics created from original aerial photographs. Designating symbol TC; form of individual image numbering: TC-1-[number], TC-2-[number], TC-3-[number], or TC-4-[number]."Date of completion 09-09-37" Flown by Gatschet Aerial Surveys, Des Moines, Iowa."Approximate scale, 1:20,000" [refers to individual images from which mosaic was made]. Library's copy 2 consists of photographic negatives (4 x 5 in.) corresponding to each of the images in its copy 1.
